findings.highlight: the original draft from another publisher
findings.evidenceJa: 外注から上がってきた原稿
findings.explanation: Matsuoka hands Haruki copy delivered by an outside contractor or freelancer for proofreading. The translation invents another publishing house, changing the production relationship.
findings.japanese:
「これ、外注から上がってきた原稿。
校正頼む、８時までに！」
findings.todokanai: "This is the original draft from another publisher. I'll leave the editing to you, it's due by 8 o'clock!"

findings.highlight: Hospital admission fees nowadays are 100000 yen, keep that in mind.
findings.evidenceJa: 今ごろ入院してるに１０万円
findings.explanation: Suzuki bets 100,000 yen that Matsuoka would be hospitalized by now if he had worked directly under Mari. The translation turns the wager into a statement about hospital admission fees, destroying the joke and its warning about Mari's workload.
findings.todokanai: "Hospital admission fees nowadays are 100000 yen, keep that in mind."

findings.highlight: Aside from the chief editor, everyone else there is a pro at editing.
findings.evidenceJa: あそこ編集長以外全部編プロだもんねぇ
findings.explanation: 編プロ means editorial-production companies or outsourced editorial staff: Ensemble's chief editor is the only in-house editor, which is why he wants a dedicated subordinate. The translation reads プロ literally as 'professionals,' erasing the staffing arrangement.
findings.japanese:
「あそこ編集長以外全部編プロだもんねぇ。
この前、専任の部下が欲しいってブツブツ言ってた」
findings.todokanai: "Aside from the chief editor, everyone else there is a pro at editing. The chief grumbled earlier about wanting someone to work directly under him."

findings.highlight: I'd rather not transfer responsibility in my first year working here properly!
findings.evidenceJa: 一年目で異動なんてこっちも御免ですから
findings.explanation: Haruki says he has no desire to be transferred to another department in his first year, responding to the possibility that Ensemble may poach him. 'Transfer responsibility' changes a personnel move into delegating a task.
findings.japanese:
「問題ないですから！
一年目で異動なんてこっちも御免ですから！
それじゃ行ってきます」
findings.todokanai: "That's not a problem! I'd rather not transfer responsibility in my first year working here properly! I'll head out now."

findings.highlight: She wanted to work as a designer
findings.evidenceJa: 企画職を希望してたけど
findings.explanation: Io wanted a planning or product-development position, not design work. The mistranslation changes her intended career function before explaining that she was placed in HR administration.
findings.japanese:
企画職を希望してたけど、なかなか競争率が高いらしく、
今は人事部で事務仕事に忙殺される毎日だとか。
findings.todokanai: She wanted to work as a designer, but since it's too competitive, she's now busy working in the HR department.

findings.highlight: nor does it usually make distinctions between people
findings.evidenceJa: しかも、別段なる気もなく
findings.explanation: Setsuna works in an environment where she cannot become an artist and, moreover, has no particular intention of becoming one. The translation replaces her lack of artistic ambition with an unrelated claim that the workplace does not distinguish between people.
findings.japanese:
そんなふうに、アーティストにはなれない環境で、
しかも、別段なる気もなく…
findings.todokanai: It's not an environment that promotes becoming an artist, nor does it usually make distinctions between people…

findings.highlight: Even though many regrettable things have happened
findings.evidenceJa: そんな、ちょっとだけ後ろめたいことがあったとしても
findings.explanation: Haruki concedes that there may be that one small thing he feels guilty about—his technically strained observance of the weekly rule. The translation expands it into many regrettable events, importing broad relationship guilt into a local comic qualification.
findings.japanese: そんな、ちょっとだけ後ろめたいことがあったとしても…
findings.todokanai: Even though many regrettable things have happened…

findings.highlight: My head was so filled with thoughts of disappointment
findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中が残念な思いでぐるぐる回ってたから
findings.explanation: 残念な思い refers self-mockingly to Haruki's pathetic or dirty-minded thoughts as he fails to process Setsuna's 'eat me while I'm hot' punchline. 'Thoughts of disappointment' mistakes the evaluative joke for sadness.
findings.japanese: なんて、頭の中が残念な思いでぐるぐる回ってたから…
findings.todokanai: My head was so filled with thoughts of disappointment…

findings.highlight: to rid ourselves of the impurity we bestowed upon each other
findings.evidenceJa: 互いのつけた汚れを落とすため
findings.explanation: They bathe to wash off the physical mess they left on each other during sex. Calling it 'impurity' moralizes the act and gives the fluids a spiritual taint absent from Haruki's playful narration.
findings.japanese:
思いっきり感じ合った後、
互いのつけた汚れを落とすため、
一緒に風呂に入って。
findings.todokanai: After we made love, we decided to bathe together to rid ourselves of the impurity we bestowed upon each other.

findings.highlight: Setsuna is having a harder time finding a proper topic of discussion than usual today.
findings.evidenceJa: ネタ的にちょっとだけ雪菜のテンションが下がっていた
findings.explanation: Their topic—Haruki's European trip—has lowered Setsuna's mood. She is not struggling to find something to discuss; she is already dwelling anxiously on the subject that follows.
findings.japanese:
ただ今日のお喋りは、
ネタ的にちょっとだけ雪菜のテンションが下がっていた。
findings.todokanai: It's just that Setsuna is having a harder time finding a proper topic of discussion than usual today.

findings.explanation: Setsuna asks what time his flight is, prompting Haruki to clarify that December 24 is the departure date and that he lands on the 25th. Asking when he will land makes his answer appear nonresponsive and blurs the crucial Christmas timing.

findings.highlight: We can take time off from work and spend the week together.
findings.evidenceJa: 会社、休み取ってゆっくり過ごそう？
findings.explanation: Haruki offers to take leave from work so they can spend relaxed time together after his return. The translation invents an entire week off, a substantial practical promise absent from the source.
findings.japanese:
「帰ったら、すぐに会いに行くから。
会社、休み取ってゆっくり過ごそう？」
findings.todokanai: "When I come back, I'll come to you right away… We can take time off from work and spend the week together."

findings.evidenceJa: 結局、土曜日のデートは
findings.explanation: The visit to the travel agency and Ogiso home occurs during their Saturday date, not Sunday.
findings.japanese:
というわけで、
結局、土曜日のデートは…
findings.todokanai: And with that, our Sunday date went something like this…

findings.highlight: if I don't take the initiative to apologize, I don't think he would be able to calm himself.
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえず自主的に謝らなければ気が済まなかった
findings.explanation: Haruki says that although he does not know why he must apologize, he himself would not feel right unless he voluntarily did so. The translation makes Setsuna's father the person unable to calm down, altering Haruki's compulsive politeness.
findings.japanese:
どうして自分が謝らなければならないのかわからないけど、
とりあえず自主的に謝らなければ気が済まなかった。
findings.todokanai: I don't even know why I'm apologizing, but if I don't take the initiative to apologize, I don't think he would be able to calm himself.

findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜さんと本場のクリスマスを過ごしたいと
findings.explanation: Haruki wants to spend an authentic European Christmas with Setsuna. 本場 does not claim that Strasbourg is the historical birthplace of Christmas; the translation invents a false cultural assertion.
findings.japanese:
「仕事の都合で、クリスマスの最中は
ヨーロッパにいることになったので…
雪菜さんと本場のクリスマスを過ごしたいと」
findings.todokanai: "Since I'll be on a business trip during Christmas, and I'll be in Europe for a while… I would like to spend Christmas with Setsuna-san at the place where Christmas originated."

findings.highlight: …Or rather, it's most likely Sawako-san abusing her power…
findings.evidenceJa:
…というか、多分あれが佐和子さんの、
今現在持っている権力なんだろう。
findings.explanation: Haruki calls the impossible booking evidence of Sawako's current clout; 'abusing her power' adds an ethical accusation.
findings.japanese:
…というか、多分あれが佐和子さんの、
今現在持っている権力なんだろう。
findings.todokanai: …Or rather, it's most likely Sawako-san abusing her power…

findings.highlight: Since I had her mother and Takahiro-kun on my side
findings.evidenceJa: けれどお母さん、孝宏君を味方に引き入れた、『俺を除く』雪菜たちの攻撃は苛烈で
findings.explanation: Setsuna's side recruits her mother and Takahiro, and their offensive explicitly excludes Haruki. The translation says Haruki himself had them on his side, assigning him the coalition-building the narration disclaims.
findings.japanese:
けれどお母さん、孝宏君を味方に引き入れた、
『俺を除く』雪菜たちの攻撃は苛烈で、
もはやお父さん一人では守勢に回るしかなく…
findings.todokanai: Since I had her mother and Takahiro-kun on my side, under the relentless assault from everyone aside from me, her father could do nothing but remain on the defense…

findings.highlight: Setsuna is staring at me with a confused expression.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜が、俺のそんな戸惑い気味の表情を覗き込む
findings.explanation: Setsuna peers into Haruki's somewhat bewildered face. The translation puts the confused expression on Setsuna, reversing who is emotionally unsettled by the Ogiso family's open declaration of love.
findings.japanese: と、雪菜が、俺のそんな戸惑い気味の表情を覗き込む。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna is staring at me with a confused expression.
